text:
Jules: Heads-up — starting Garnet region kickoff with PlanetCloud + VertexSI. Need marketplace SKU approval + coloc partner cert. ETA: two weeks.
Maya: @Jules added PlanetCloud PM (cc: @Arun) — they need GPU quota estimates and KMS flow. PlanetCloud requires HSM attestation for Private deployments.
Arun: hi all — we can support dedicated A100 pools in Garnet3, but quota provisioning needs legal sign-off for cross-border data transfer. Can get initial 50 vGPUs.
Devon: 50 vGPUs is fine. Need exact instance SKU names and expected sustained tokens/sec to size nodepools.
Jules: @Devon we'll send a traffic profile by EOD. Also need marketplace listing metadata: SKU, billing unit, region mapping, meter id.
Sam: For joint announcement, Marketing needs a greenlight checklist: capacity SLA, partner logo approval, and launch date. Prefer 2026-04-10 if approvals finished.
Ankur: HSM/KMS integration: PlanetCloud uses their KMS; we must confirm CMEK flow and key residency. Also need SOC2 attestation copy.
Maya: @Ankur we'll ask PlanetCloud for the attestation. @Arun can you confirm KMS endpoints and whether they support IAM federation?
Arun: They support IAM federation via OIDC; KMS endpoints regionalized in Garnet. I'll share docs link: https://planetcloud.example/keys
Devon: ops question — is there a fallback plan if PlanetCloud onboarding delayed? Could route traffic to eu-west3 temporarily.
Jules: yes — fallback to eu-west3 with feature-flagged rollout and canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need capacity gating ticket for ops.
Sam: Marketing will hold announcement until SLA and billing tests pass. Please tag @release-bot when the final checklist is ready.
Ops-bot: capacity-ticket-#452 created by Devon for Garnet quota provisioning — https://redwood.internal/tickets/452 :white_check_mark:
Jules: Action items: 1) @Arun send SKUs + KMS doc by EOD; 2) @Devon create capacity gating ticket (done); 3) @Ankur request SOC2 + HSM attestation; 4) @Sam draft marketing copy by Fri.
Maya: Got it. Ping me if any blockers. :rocket:
